name: early-compaction
title: Enable early percentage compaction and track the compaction extensions
description: Add @thunstack/auto-compact to give a 30% context trigger (native Pi only triggers at contextWindow - reserveTokens, i.e. ~98% on a 1M model), track the already-installed @sting8k/pi-vcc in the same pass, resolve the resulting settings.json drift, and declare both per-machine extension config files in .gitignore and PI_NOT_SYNCED. Includes a mandatory test of the one real risk: auto-compact's autoResume may double-resume now that Pi core (>=0.84.4) resumes the run itself.
creator: yuanhai.tan
notes: Always-on: @thunstack/auto-compact (percentage trigger) + @sting8k/pi-vcc (already installed but untracked, so doctor.sh is failing with render drift). Design: auto-compact owns WHEN (thresholdPercent 30), pi-vcc owns HOW (overrideDefaultCompaction true, algorithmic, no LLM call -- so the 0.8*reserveTokens summary budget is irrelevant and reserveTokens stays untouched). The two config files are per-machine and must NOT be symlinked: writeAutoCompactConfig uses renameSync, which replaces a symlink rather than its target (index.ts:133-166). Open risk being tested, not assumed: auto-compact's autoResume may duplicate core's resume on Pi >=0.84.4 (pi-vcc's docs warn a second continue 'would land as a ghost turn'). Start autoResume:false and verify work completes exactly once.
